title: Easy and sturdy frame
text: Easy and sturdy frame. This is a great frame that fits our mattress perfectly....I just wish the mattress fit down in the frame instead of sit on top because it sometimes shifts but the frame itself is very sturdy and sleek and does not shift or move

product_metadata.title: ZINUS Abel Metal Platform Bed Frame / Mattress Foundation with Steel Slat Support / No Box Spring Needed / Easy Assembly, King, Black
features: Queen bed frame, 12" Solid wood platform bed frame W/grand wooden slat (no box Spring needed), Antique Espresso, Queen Size.Item Dimensions : 79.5"L x 75.5"W x 14"H.Maximum weight recommendation:700 pounds
NO BOX SPRING NEEDED - Reliable metal slats are designed to support and extend the life of your latex, memory foam or spring mattress without the need for a box spring

RECESSED LEGS AND UNDER BED STORAGE SPACE - A 14 inch platform features recessed side legs for even better support with no stubbed toes, and its 12 inches of under bed space is perfect for storing extra odds and ends

EASY ASSEMBLY - Metal slats are secured with fewer bolts to save you time and hassle; all parts, tools and instructions are shipped straight to your door in one efficiently packed box; set-up takes less than hour with a friend’s help
Worry-free 5 year limited warranty included; mattress sold separately; twin size supports a maximum weight capacity of 350 lbs, while all other sizes can support up to 700 lbs
description: Think that a bed that comes in the mail has to make you tear your hair out before it can be put together? The Abel Metal Platform Bed might make you think again. We’ve figured out a simpler way to construct a bed frame via this design’s Quick Lock assembly system. Because this frame features a set of thick steel support slats that can be snapped into place in no time, giving you a sound foundation that’s ready in under an hour. No outside tools or engineering degree required. The result of your hard (ish) work? A sleek and uncompromisingly stable bed that polishes the look of your bedroom, requires no box spring, and even gives you some extra under bed space for storage. And to go with it, we offer a 5-year warranty because we’re in the business of having your back, so you can stay in the business of getting great sleep.
